_approach: A generic EDM kick-roll build (8ths accelerating into 16ths, velocity climbing to 127) rather than a dariacore-specific device — this is the honest limit of drum-only builds here: the genre's actual build tension comes from the sample being flipped (a vocal chop sped up, a filter opening on the source track), not from the drum pattern alone, so this riser only covers the generic 'kick roll into the drop' skeleton a dariacore producer would drum underneath their sample edit. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
